snippet.title: [GAME IN DEV | CHATGPT +UNITY] Negotiate Your Way Out: An Immersive Yandere Escape Room
snippet.description:
The demo is out! link here: https://helixngc7293.itch.io/yandere-ai-girlfriend-simulator

Just updated a devlog about how to setup the keys, hope it help. If not, let me know what did you try and what issues you have.
https://helixngc7293.itch.io/yandere-ai-girlfriend-simulator/devlog/511529/yandere-ai-girlfriend-simulator-demo-api-setup-tutorial

Thanks for watching this video introducing our new escape room game featuring a Yandere cat girl powered by chatGPT! The game challenges players to negotiate their way to freedom using their communication skills.

We used Unity engine, chatGPT and Azure Text to Speech service. 

We chose this game's character and plot to encourage players to consider how to properly and effectively treat individuals with complex personalities.

Lots of updates are coming! Also we may have a demo that you could play soon.

If you have any questions or comments, please feel free to contact us. Thanks again for watching!

the equipment&software&anything else I used in this video:
(which I could think of..)
Nikon Z6, 24-70mm
RØDE Stereo VideoMic X
RØDE wireless go ii
Shure Super55 microphone
Anker PowerConf C200 webcam
